title: 实验设计与判读
scope: Product experiments, randomization, primary outcomes, guardrails, power, stopping and rollout decisions.
routingDescription: Product experiments, randomization, primary outcomes, guardrails, power, stopping and rollout decisions.
useWhen: Plan or interpret an A/B test
Repeated peeking, assignment or measurement may invalidate a test

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use causal inference for existing non-randomized interventions.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Define intervention, mechanism, target population and the decision the test will inform.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Choose an interpretable contrast and a testable hypothesis.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When exposure or analysis units differ
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check randomization unit, contamination, clustering, sample-ratio mismatch and instrumentation drift.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Resolve assignment and measurement failures before interpreting treatment effects.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Separate a prespecified primary metric, guardrails and diagnostic secondary metrics.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Apply the decision rule to the correct outcome family and protect guardrails.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When sizing or monitoring a test
diagnosticChecklist.check: State baseline, minimum detectable effect in explicit units, power, error budget and stopping plan.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Use an appropriate fixed-horizon or sequential method rather than repeated ordinary significance checks.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Compare uncertainty and practical effect against the planned decision and guardrails.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Distinguish inconclusive evidence from equivalence and specify the next decision.

evidenceRequirements: Primary and guardrail definitions plus instrumentation checks
Baseline, MDE definition, sample size, duration and stopping plan
qualityChecks: Check sample-ratio mismatch and guardrail outcomes
Absolute and relative MDE are not interchangeable
riskRules: Consequential product or health interventions need domain-specific review beyond a generic A/B checklist

preferredSources: Documented randomization and measurement behavior of the actual experiment platform
Original references for the selected fixed-horizon or sequential procedure
refreshTriggers: Statistical procedure and platform-specific experiment constraints
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: A test was stopped after the first significant day and revenue guardrails fell.
examples.expected: Inspect stopping bias and guardrails before a rollout recommendation.
examples.reject: Declare victory from the favorable primary p-value alone.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
